'''Kiharaphor Engineering''' was an engineering corporation operating during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Kinakt Losron]] was a member of an evaluation team sent to [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] to investigate the possibility or setting up a facility on the planet. The team was captured and forced to work for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].
